definitions.explanation: Describes someone who lacks skill or ability in something. The opposite of {上手|じょうず} (skillful). Can be self-deprecating when used about oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下手|へた}で⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
{下手|へた}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even if I'm not good at it, let's give it a try.

notes: The opposite of ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧. Uses the same grammar pattern: ～が{下手|へた}です (bad at ~). It's considered polite in Japanese to be modest about your own abilities, so saying {下手|へた}です about yourself is common and not necessarily negative. Avoid using it directly about others as it can be rude.
